content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Cost Optimization for Robotics Research Initiatives
agenda_items: Review of current research project expenditure across European partners
Discussion on potential open-source hardware/software alternatives for research platforms
Evaluation of collaborative procurement strategies for specialized robotics components
key_decisions: Prioritize exploration of open-source ROS 2 compatible hardware options for next-generation research prototypes.
Form a working group to benchmark current expenditure against industry best practices within the next month.
action_items: Professor Kai Lundgren: Lead the working group for expenditure benchmarking and report initial findings in 3 weeks.
Dr. Elena Petrova: Research and present viable open-source robotics hardware alternatives, due in 2 weeks.
All Attendees: Submit suggestions for shared infrastructure opportunities to Professor Lundgren by the end of next week.
